physical_probe_v2.interpretation: The two observed flag states match emulation. End/limit results differ, but v2 did not validate baseline RAM transfers and omitted the documented transfer termination/flag/BRDY sequence. Boundary behavior remains inconclusive.

physical_probe_v3.interpretation: Baseline returns the final written byte C8 in all eight positions. No BUSY/BRDY timeout. Boundary tests correctly skipped; no conclusion about chip end/limit semantics.

physical_probe_v4.conclusion: On the tested Makoto on both hosts, explicit ADPCM reset followed by read mode changes B repeated-last-byte output to C correct sequential data. Both reselected/flag-handshake reads (C) and stream reads (D) work. Reset/read setup is isolated; original end/limit boundary behavior is not yet established. These are two host tests, not evidence of two independent cartridge samples.

physical_probe_v5.hardware_scope: Owner-tested Makoto on two MSX hosts; not claimed to be two independent cartridge/chip samples.
conclusions: Both normal RAM gates pass, no timeout, four end-test data writes submitted.
At end register 0000h in x1 mode, all four bytes A1-A4 are stored. Current emulation drops A4.
At limit register 0000h in x1 mode, reads wrap after B4. Current emulation wraps after B3.
Observed masked/unmasked status values 00h/08h match emulation.
No claim about exact EOS timing, writes beyond end, other memory modes, or playback end behavior from this probe.
